qualification_summary: AFC used five qualifying rounds. Rounds 1 and 2 also served as 2027 AFC Asian Cup qualification. The top two in each third-round group qualified directly; third/fourth-place teams moved to the fourth round; fourth-round group winners qualified; fourth-round runners-up played a fifth-round tie for the AFC inter-confederation playoff place. Iraq then won the inter-confederation playoff final to become AFC's ninth qualifier.
Nine group winners qualified directly. Four best runners-up entered a CAF playoff; the playoff winner advanced to the FIFA inter-confederation playoffs.

confederation_name: Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football
region_description: North America, Central America and Caribbean
qualification_summary: Canada, Mexico, and the United States qualified automatically as hosts. The remaining 32 FIFA-affiliated CONCACAF teams played a first round, second round group stage, and third round final group stage. Third-round group winners qualified directly; the two best runners-up advanced to the inter-confederation play-offs.

region_description: South American qualifying: one 10-team home-and-away league table. Top six qualified directly; seventh advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.
qualification_summary: All 10 CONMEBOL teams played a double round-robin league from September 2023 to September 2025. Argentina, Ecuador, Colombia, Uruguay, Brazil, and Paraguay qualified directly. Bolivia finished seventh and advanced to the inter-confederation playoff, where it lost to Iraq.

region_description: Oceania and Pacific football qualification pathway
qualification_summary: Eleven eligible OFC teams entered. Four lowest-ranked teams played a Round One knockout. The winner joined seven seeded teams in Round Two, split into two groups of four. The top two from each group advanced to the Third Round knockout. The Third Round winner qualified directly for the 2026 World Cup; the runner-up advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.

UEFA qualifying used a first-round group stage of twelve groups, followed by four single-leg play-off paths. Each group winner qualified directly for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The twelve group runners-up and four best eligible 2024-25 UEFA Nations League group winners entered the play-offs, where each path winner qualified.
